argument_text: Here knowledge is the cause of liberation, since it opposes ignorance, the cause of bondage. Ignorance is twofold: located in the intellect, and personal. The intellect-located is doubt-natured and wrong-conviction-natured. The personal is thought-natured and contracted-manifestation-natured — and that itself is the root cause of saṃsāra, as will be taught under the determination of the stains. There, personal ignorance may be removed by initiation and the rest — but initiation itself is impossible while intellect-located, determination-less ignorance persists, since initiation is preceded by determination of shun-and-take and takes the form of principle-purification and Śiva-joining. Hence determinative, intellect-abiding knowledge is principal; practiced, that itself kills personal ignorance too, since thought-consciousness-practice ends in thought-free. For the self — consciousness-light uncontracted by thought — is Śiva-natured. Hence in all cases adopt all-thing-directed right-determination knowledge. And that is scripture-led: scripture authoritative only as Lord-spoken, since others' scripture-taught things are accepted there discriminatively and since there is reason-proved exposition beyond their content. Hence other-āgama-taught knowledge liberates only so far from bondage, not from all; from all liberates the Lord's scripture, five-streamed, ten-eighteen-eight-differentiated. Than all that, the essence is the sixfold scriptures; than those, the Mālinīvijaya — whose contained content, gathered, is impossible to expound. Nor is there freedom or liberating power for one whose thing-nature is unexpounded, since only pure knowledge is so-natured. Since the supreme goal is rooted in well-practiced knowledge, for its success this is begun. Ignorance, declared bondage-cause in scripture, is called stain; at the rise of the digit of full knowledge, all that goes rootless. When self-consciousness rises with remainderless destroyed stains — liberation too. Hence by this man, with scripture, I reveal entirely whatever knowable reality there may be.
